answer: Agents bond stake to an identity commitment and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose Shamir shares are encoded in valid RLN proofs. Reusing a rate-limit nullifier for duplicate messages exposes the bound identity secret, enabling the contract to verify misconduct and slash the associated collateral without revealing unrelated identities. Semaphore membership proofs establish eligibility; the polynomial and nullifier enforce one message per limit. Like a knoll above a terrace bordered by cedar, each layer has a distinct role.
